text: would like it even better if you would offer a one time payment instead of subscription, which is difficult to manage with ADHD. Also, why is the trial only 3 days? That's very short
author: Olga Veldhorst
developer_reply: Hey there, Thanks for reaching out and for the thoughtful feedback on our subscription options. I’ve passed your message along to our team to consider as we continue to upgrade the app. I can’t promise that your suggestion will be implemented, but we welcome any feedback from our customers and could implement that in the future.

text: Was great, then the ads came... Such a shame! Greed has done it again 💸
author: Niels Lammertyn
developer_reply: Hallo, bedankt voor je feedback! Om Opal gratis te houden en het team te ondersteunen, worden er in de gratis versie af en toe advertenties getoond. Opal Pro verwijdert deze advertenties voor een ononderbroken ervaring. We zijn ook bezig met het verbeteren van de gratis versie om je te helpen gefocust te blijven. Met vriendelijke groet, Team Opal
